description: This file is a React component representing a roadmap page in a web application. It includes a mind map visualization, milestone timeline, and UI for managing roles and milestones within a roadmap planning tool. The code handles rendering interactive nodes, edges, tooltips, and user interactions for expanding/collapsing categories, editing milestones, and switching views.

methods.name: safeParseStringArray
methods.description: Safely parses a comma-separated string of role IDs stored in localStorage into a string array.

methods.name: uid
methods.description: Generates a unique identifier string with a specified prefix.

methods.name: clamp
methods.description: Clamps a number between two bounds.

methods.name: todayISO
methods.description: Returns today's date in ISO format (YYYY-MM-DD).

methods.name: progressRingTone
methods.description: Returns color classes for progress ring based on percentage.

methods.name: milestoneProgress
methods.description: Calculates progress percentage based on milestone status.

methods.name: milestoneClusterIndex
methods.description: Determines the cluster index for a milestone for grouping purposes.

methods.name: seedRolePlan
methods.description: Creates a default role plan with milestones and skills based on roleId.

methods.name: loadRoadmapState
methods.description: Loads the roadmap state (active role and plans) from localStorage.

methods.name: persistRoadmapState
methods.description: Saves the current roadmap state to localStorage.

methods.name: buildCategories
methods.description: Constructs categories with subnodes for the mind map with predefined skills and statuses.
